Kong Kong'er stood in a black dress, his eyes falling on the two quasi-sages, and he began to explore them. Although he complained, Huo Lingfeng still put her on the bed gently, and then kissed her face every day. It looked like he couldn't get enough of it. But Zhuang Qingqing didn't know anything about it. He just enjoyed the feeling that someone had prepared everything when he got up in the morning. He came over and disappeared without a trace within a few seconds. Scarface knew that he had encountered a tough situation, but he had stumbled here today, so he couldn't let it go, so he said, "Just wait for me, I'll go call someone else." He was so powerful that he immediately lost his temper, and he felt the desire to escape. "I need to go to Australia the day after tomorrow, and I need to complete a large project in three days." Sure enough, Huo Lingfeng said gloomily, "Don't dare!" Cui Daqing stiffened and turned around to smile, his smile uglier than crying. His face, which had always been stern, was now like an ice sculpture without any trace of tenderness. His sharp eyes were like two knives piercing Zhuang Qing's face. . Zhuang Qing couldn't help but feel a flash of fear in his heart. Lu Jing never thought that the reason why Chen Tian could activate this mysterious sword in such a short period of time was just because he secretly used the power of the immortal. The overlord in the world had no magic weapon that could resist the immortal power, so Chen Tiancai was able to barely use the Xuanjin Immortal Sword. However, Gong Shaoqing did not show up, and Lu Yuan had an incomprehensible temperament. Ye Zihan was almost driven crazy by Lu Yuan's temperament.
